implementation: Use resolved callable mutability masks in lowering effect analyses instead of syntactic NF_MUT receiver permission. Read a direct function mask from its cached checked signature, with the existing declaration scan as fallback; indirect calls use their function type. Apply this to writes, resizes, loop footprints, closed-program ownership, race/determinism checks and closure argument pinning.
user_behavior: A read-only method such as values.first() can run inside loop @item in values, including local, nested-field and transitive global reads. Read-only captured methods work in parallel callbacks. Actual mutable arguments, indirect mutable calls and hidden global resizing remain rejected where required.
scope: No syntax changes; source NF_MUT permissions remain intact. This uses the same resolved mutability as argument lowering rather than changing the meaning of @ or closure capture semantics.
